features.title: Days of your choice
features.text: Pick the exact days and hours of the occasion, then share its link.

features.title: Ranges with the mouse
features.text: Drag to enter your availability, several ranges per day, with a finger on a phone.

features.title: In real time
features.text: Everyone sees the others' availability appear as it is entered.

features.title: Best moments
features.text: A heat map brings out the times when the most people are free.

features.title: Invitations by email
features.text: Invite people by their email: each one receives a personal link that takes them to the occasion.

features.title: Organizations
features.text: Group your members under a logo and invite them all in one click.

features.title: Custom logos
features.text: Upload your logo or create one in the gallery: symbol, text, font, light or dark background.

features.title: French and English
features.text: The application, its messages and its emails are available in both languages.

features.title: Simple and private
features.text: No sign-up: you come in through a link. Optional password, a single essential cookie, and a QR code to switch to your phone.

shots.title: Everyone's calendar
shots.text: Day, Week or Month view: each guest's bar shows the start time, their initials and the end time. On the right, the members and, greyed out, the people invited by email who have not opened their link yet.
shots.alt: Week view: each guest's availability bars; on the right, the members and a person invited by email, greyed out

shots.title: The right time, at a glance
shots.text: The report ranks the best times and places them on a heat map. Dark mode included.
shots.alt: Report: heat map and best times, in dark mode

shots.title: All your occasions
shots.text: Ongoing, upcoming, the ones you manage and the archives, filtered by organization.
shots.alt: List of occasions with organization logos and a crown for the ones you manage

shots.title: A logo for your group
shots.text: In the gallery, pick a symbol, write the text, choose the font and the background: the logo is ready. You can create several and switch from one to another.
shots.alt: Creating a logo: text “Les Sommets”, Elegant font, Outdoors symbol selected

heroTitle: Find the time when everyone is free
heroText: Disponibilités is a group calendar: create an occasion, share its link, and each guest enters the times they're available. Everyone sees the others' availabilities, in real time.
inviteText: Open the link of an occasion someone shared with you: you will be added to it automatically and can then create your own occasions.
inviteDevice: Already using the application on another device? Choose “📱 Link a phone” there and scan the QR code with this one.
mobileText: The editor folds into two rows, morning and afternoon: tap to add a time slot, drag its edges to adjust it. A QR code is all it takes to find your occasions on your phone.
mobileAlt: Time slot editor on a phone: two rows, morning / afternoon
